leaves.name: carayolThmAIrr
leaves.doc: Carayol 1986, Theoreme (A), at F = Q, weight 2, packaged printed form over K_{f,lambda}, with Ribet's irreducibility and oddness (r17-print, r17-rebase): for a printed newform f (Tau Ceti Newform N 2) with number field K_f and a place lambda | l of K_f, there is a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(K_{f,lambda}) (Mathlib adicCompletion), irreducible (no stable subspace other than 0 and K_{f,lambda}^2), odd (some involution c in G_Q has det rho(c) = -1), unramified at p not dividing N l with arithmetic-Frobenius trace a_p(f), whose Serre-Tate conductor exponent at every prime p != l is v_p(N). The passage to r17 (Burnside's form from irreducible + odd; IsNewform = printed newform; extension of scalars to Qbar_l; absolute irreducibility gives semisimplicity; conductor invariance under scalar extension and isomorphism; Brauer-Nesbitt with Chebotarev) is proved in Lean. Replaces r17-print's carayolThmA (CarayolPrinted.carayolThmA_of_irr), which replaced r17.
leaves.flag: pending reading: conductor clause (DDT 1997 Thm 3.1 / Carayol 1986 0.8) (inbox 6: counts GLUE until the reading lands); unread: new printed leaf (packaged form); reading risk: Carayol 1986 Theoreme (A) as printed is local-global compatibility of rho_{f,lambda}|G_{Q_p} with pi_{f,p} through the local Langlands correspondence; the leaf's conductor clause (condExp = v_p(N) at p != l) follows from it only with Casselman 1973 (a(pi_p) = v_p(N) for newforms) and the conductor compatibility of the local correspondence (locator audit row R17 rates the conductor equality a CONSEQUENCE of these); it is printed as one statement only if the packaged form in Darmon-Diamond-Taylor 1997 Thm 3.1 or Carayol section 0.8 states it (UNVERIFIED); if the statement check finds the packaging unprinted, re-flag 'pending reading' (count-neutral) or fold the split form (CarayolExistence + CarayolConductor). Irreducibility is Ribet's plain form (Burnside's form proved in Lean from irreducible + odd); oddness from det rho = psi chi_l; locators UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Carayol, Ann. Sci. ENS (4) 19 (1986) 409-468, Theoreme (A), pp. 409-411 and section 0.8 p. 411 (coverage read by the locator audit, row R17); Casselman, Math. Ann. 201 (1973) (a(pi_p) = v_p(N)); Ribet, LNM 601 (1977) Thm 2.3 (irreducibility); Shimura 1971 Thm 7.14 and Deligne 1971 (existence, traces, det); Darmon-Diamond-Taylor, Fermat's Last Theorem (1997) Thm 3.1 (packaging); locators UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: modularHTPrinted
leaves.doc: R13, printed existence form, reading-robust (htnew-print): for a prime l, embeddings iota_C, iota_L and a Tau Ceti newform f of weight k >= 2 and level N (every level, l | N included), there is a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(Qbar_l), unramified outside N l, with either (arithmetic Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, 1-k}) or (geometric Frobenius trace a_p and Hodge-Tate weights {0, k-1}) (kernel convention: cyclotomic weight -1). No semisimplicity asked; the trace clause is 'if iota_C(alpha) = a_p then tr = iota_L(alpha)'. Replaces eigenformHTNew: semisimplification preserves HT weights, the dual, the newform dictionary and the Chebotarev/Brauer-Nesbitt transport are proved in Lean (EigenformHTPrinted.lean).

leaves.name: panPrintedP
leaves.doc: R12. Pan, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 35 (2022), 1031-1169, Theorem 1.0.4 (= arXiv:1901.07166v2 Thm 1.0.4 with Conj. 1.0.1, pp. 5 and 2; JAMS number and page UNVERIFIED), p >= 5, for each iota_p : Qbar_p = C, printed form for one continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(Qbar_p): rho irreducible (no stable subspace but 0 and Qbar_p^2), unramified outside finitely many primes, odd, rho|G_Qp potentially semistable (Fontaine admissibility over Berger's B_st = B_max[log p~] inside B_dR, on a model V = E^n) and with distinct Hodge-Tate weights (multiplicity of w = dim_E (V (x)_Qp C_p(w))^{G_Qp}, cyclotomic weight -1) => rho comes from a cuspidal eigenform up to twist: a cuspidal eigenform g (Tau Ceti EigenformAwayFromLevel N k), rho_g attached to g through iota_p (tr rho_g(Frob_q^geom) = iota_p^-1(lambda_q(g)) and unramified, almost all q), a continuous character psi and P in GL_2(Qbar_p) with rho(s) = psi(s) P rho_g(s) P^-1

leaves.name: bergerPrintedV
